name: sequenceNumber
description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for the message

name: currency
description: The currency of the price (e.g., USD, EUR)

name: venue
description: The exchange or venue where the price originated

name: timestamp
description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the price was generated

name: bidAsk
description: Indicates if the price is a bid or an ask

name: quantity
description: The quantity available at this price

name: publishTime
description: The time when the message was published to BigQuery

name: ingestion_time
description: The time when the message was ingested into BigQuery
